findings.highlight: you care more about cleaning up Caster's mess
findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの事をはっきりさせたいんじゃないのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou anticipates Rin prioritizing finding out what is going on, before fighting other Masters.
findings.explanation: Clarifying Caster’s situation becomes cleaning up her mess.

findings.highlight: I can't stop someone else from taking advantage of it
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かに利用されるのは仕方ないけど
findings.governingReading: 誰かに利用されるのは仕方ない permits being used herself; the objection is acting without knowing whom she harms and how.
findings.explanation: Rin accepting being used becomes inability to stop others taking advantage of the war.

findings.highlight: Don't be scared—I won't tell anyone.
findings.evidenceJa: 口にするつもりないから怯えなくていいわよ
findings.governingReading: Rin promises not to verbalize it to Shirou; he says hearing it from her would hurt, and she immediately voices it to him.
findings.explanation: Speaking the teasing diagnosis aloud becomes telling other people.

findings.highlight: it'll be two or three times worse.
findings.evidenceJa: 二倍や三倍じゃすまない気がする
findings.governingReading: 二倍や三倍じゃすまない says the impact from Rin would exceed those multipliers.
findings.explanation: More than two or three times becomes two or three times.
